message.content: {"question":"For all t ∈ R, consider the triangle having vertices in P₁ = (3,2,1), P₂ = (t,1,1), P₃ = (1,2,t). Which of the following statements is true? (a) The edges P₁P₂ and P₂P₃ are orthogonal for t = 3. (b) There is no value of t such that the edges P₁P₂ and P₁P₃ are orthogonal. (c) The edges P₁P₂ and P₁P₃ are orthogonal for at least one value of t. (d) The edges P₁P₂ and P₂P₃ are orthogonal for two different values of t.","options":{"A":"The edges P₁P₂ and P₂P₃ are orthogonal for t = 3.","B":"There is no value of t such that the edges P₁P₂ and P₁P₃ are orthogonal.","C":"The edges P₁P₂ and P₁P₃ are orthogonal for at least one value of t.","D":"The edges P₁P₂ and P₂P₃ are orthogonal for two different values of t."},"correct":"C"}
